page.overview:
Who is Officer Baker?

Officer Baker is a police officer with the Haddonfield Police Department. He is called upon to investigate an attempted murder on Lori Parker and Jake Kovac, who had a tree knocked down towards them as they were riding a motorcycle down a road by Jake's house. When Officer Baker arrived to investigate the fallen tree, he was attacked and brutally murdered by Michael Myers with an axe to his head.
